meta.parties: Dodwell & Co. Ltd. v. John Et Al

rules.statement: In Ceylon, the cause of action for fraud arises when the cheques are received and dealt with by the appellants, not when they discover the fraud later.
rules.supporting_quote: "Their Lordships are, therefore, of opinion that, according to the law of Ceylon, the cause of action accrued., under the circumstances of this case, at the dates when the cheques were received and dealt with by the appellants"
